name: artifacts
description: Render agent output as a self-contained black-and-white HTML page with an in-page annotation layer that hands comments back as a markdown digest.

interface.shortDescription: Render agent output as a self-contained black-and-white HTML page with an in-page annotation layer that hands comments back as a markdown digest.
interface.longDescription: Pages are written to .agents/artifacts/ in the current project and opened in your browser, with no network access and no build step. Mark a passage, leave a note, then press Copy for agent and paste the markdown digest back into the session to have the page revised.
